materials.name: grass

Crisp fine illustration detail and restrained original 2000s cartoon palette. No scene, perspective, objects, lettering, lighting gradients, borders or watermark. Even neutral illumination with no large cast shadows. All four edges must join seamlessly. Intended as a subtle repeating detail overlay on the original map, so keep contrast restrained and patterns small.
